parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The number of the page to return. Pages start from Page 1.

parameters.name: DriverId
parameters.description:
The ID of the driver. To obtain the driver ID, perform the following steps: Log on to the [Link IoT Edge console](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list). On the **Drivers** page, move the pointer over the name of the driver whose versions you want to query and obtain the driver ID.

You can also call the [QueryEdgeDriver](~~155776~~) operation to query the driver ID.

parameters.name: DriverVersion
parameters.description: The version number of the driver. To query information about a specific driver version, set this parameter to the specific version number.

parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the Internet of Things (IoT) service instance. This parameter is not required for the public instance but required for Enterprise Edition instances.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page. Valid values: 1 to 30. Default value: 10.

parameters.name: VersionState
parameters.description:
The status of the driver version. Valid values:

*   0: The driver version to be queried is not published.
*   1: The driver version to be queried is published.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun iot query-edge-driver-version --iot-instance-id iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000 --page-size 15 --current-page 1 --driver-id fec565038d7544978d9aed5c1a000000 --driver-version 'led驱动' --version-state 0 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun iot QueryEdgeDriverVersion --region cn-hangzhou --DriverId fec565038d7544978d9aed5c1a000000 --IotInstanceId 'iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000' --PageSize 15 --DriverVersion 'led驱动' --CurrentPage 1 --VersionState 0
